name: cli-portable-resumable-checkpoint-transfer
instr:
The checkpoint library cannot move checkpoints safely between storage topologies. Add portable, deterministic transfer for offline handoff, backup, recovery, and migration. Every PersistentStore must export complete logical state and import through native publication semantics across interruptions, backend coexistence, composed stores, files, and standard streams.

Metadata-branch, checkpoint-refs, and filesystem backends must produce byte-identical, canonically ordered transfers for equivalent checkpoints. Transfers identify and summarize the complete checkpoint. Missing checkpoints return ErrCheckpointNotFound without completing the stream.

Import must validate identity, version, framing, digests, and anchored unique paths before atomically exposing content. Report malformed input as ErrInvalidTransfer with the exact text "invalid checkpoint transfer". Preserve every session, optional field, identity, and index order needed for equivalent reads.

Durable resume state must converge interruptions at TransferSeam boundaries to one publication without replay. Identical imports are idempotent. Different content returns ErrTransferConflict with the exact text "checkpoint transfer conflict" without mutation.

Keep native read, list, update, history, write-variant, push-discovery, and non-Git behavior unchanged. Route hexadecimal and ULID identities correctly during branch-and-refs coexistence. Composed imports publish the primary before mirrors and succeed despite mirror failure.
